connector.name: Scrcpy MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Android device control via ADB and scrcpy
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package scrcpy-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the juancf account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ANDROID_SERIAL
env.description: Target device serial number (from `adb devices`). Required when multiple devices are connected.

env.name: ADB_PATH
env.description: Custom path to the adb binary. Defaults to 'adb' on PATH.

env.name: SCRCPY_SERVER_PATH
env.description: Path to the scrcpy-server.jar file. Only needed if not installed in a standard location.
